name: fomor
description: A local exploration assistant for Trae: collect the questions you ask, understand what you are working on, and daily propose alternative solution paths. Long-term memory stays in ~/.fomor; nothing is injected into your agent session.

interface.shortDescription: Daily exploration of alternative solution paths based on your Trae prompts
interface.longDescription: Fomor collects the questions you send in Trae through a lightweight UserPromptSubmit hook, analyzes them daily at a configurable time (default 03:00) with a Trae automation task, and writes a discovery report to ~/.fomor. Questions you keep asking about are promoted into long-term topics; ignored discoveries expire automatically. It never injects content into your agent session.
defaultPrompt: Set up Fomor for this workspace
Show me what Fomor explored recently
